copy.hero: Every operation comes from the record of a contest among three powers, from the gas valve of 2022 to the orbits of 2031.
copy.arcsText: The United States and its allies, the Party-state and the Kremlin, played as a contest among three.
copy.opsNote: Ten operations from the record and the near future. Tier sets the difficulty.
copy.arcsNote: Two arcs. Each runs from the record into the near future, one operation at a time. Win an operation to open the next.

ops.title: The Gate at Canton
ops.brief: In August 1784 Samuel Shaw, supercargo of the Empress of China, anchored at Whampoa and learned the terms of the only gate the Qing court kept open to the West.
ops.record: The Qing court confined Western trade to Canton from 1757. Every foreign ship needed a licensed hong merchant to stand surety for its conduct and its duties, and foreigners lived in a strip of factories outside the city walls for the trading season. The Empress of China had sailed from New York in February 1784 and traded ginseng for tea and silk under those rules.
ops.reading: The security merchant made one licensed person answer for every guest, a gate built on verification rather than trust. The gate held until opium moved outside it and the gatekeepers took a cut, which is where most later gates have failed.
ops.gapText: Business Architecture. The gatekeepers earned from the traffic their office existed to stop.
ops.fix: Verify every request at the gate and audit the gatekeeper's income, the discipline zero trust now names.

ops.title: The Distillers
ops.label: October 2026 to December 2027
ops.brief: An abuse analyst at an American AI lab watches 20,000 accounts on three continents ask the lab's model the same kinds of reasoning questions in the same order. The payments trace to a cloud reseller in Singapore, and the questions read like a training curriculum.
ops.record: OpenAI said in January 2025 that it had evidence DeepSeek used its models' outputs to train a rival, a practice called distillation. Anthropic barred companies controlled from the People's Republic from its services in September 2025. Anthropic named DeepSeek, Moonshot and MiniMax for large-scale distillation on February 23, 2026. The Commerce Department proposed know-your-customer rules for foreign users of American cloud services in January 2024.
ops.reading: Distillation lets a lab copy the behavior of a frontier model for the price of its API calls. Shell accounts, resellers and rotating payment cards hide who asks. The asker keeps the lesson, and the host pays for the compute that taught it. This is Stratagem 12, take the opportunity to pilfer a goat.
ops.coreEvent: Washington sanctions or restricts a mainland AI lab for distilling American models before 2028.
ops.gapText: Application Architecture. Model access checks a credit card and not the customer behind it.
ops.fix: Pair know-your-customer checks for high-volume model access with shared abuse indicators across labs. Treat distillation at scale as trade-secret theft and prosecute it that way.

ops.title: The Dollar Workaround
ops.label: October 2026 to December 2028
ops.brief: A trade finance officer in Dubai settles a cargo of Saudi crude for a mainland refiner in March 2028. The payment never touches a dollar account, and the compliance screen in New York never sees it.
ops.record: The mBridge platform links central banks in the People's Republic and Hong Kong with Thailand, the United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia. The Bank for International Settlements left the project in October 2024. Hong Kong's stablecoin law took effect on August 1, 2025. The GENIUS Act of July 2025 set federal rules for dollar stablecoins, including the power to freeze funds under lawful order. Western governments froze the Russian central bank's reserves held abroad in February 2022.
ops.reading: The Party builds rails that route around the dollar's gate. Each rail sells speed and lower fees in the open and immunity from sanctions underneath. The convenience recruits users who never cared about sanctions. This is Stratagem 8, openly repair the gallery roads and march secretly through Chencang. A state under sanctions has the most to gain from rails the dollar cannot reach.
ops.coreEvent: Saudi Arabia settles more than 10 percent of its crude sales to the mainland in yuan before 2029.
ops.gapText: Technology Architecture. The dollar still runs on correspondent banking built decades ago, so a faster rival wins on convenience before it wins on politics.
ops.fix: Modernize dollar settlement until no trader gains by leaving it. Keep the lawful-order freeze and publish when it is used.

ops.title: The Matsu Cable
ops.label: October 2026 to December 2028
ops.brief: At 3:40 a.m. in January 2027, a network operations center in Taipei loses the signal on a cable to Matsu. Radar shows a sand barge under a flag of convenience dragging its anchor across the route at four knots.
ops.record: A Taiwanese court sentenced the captain of the Hong Tai 58 to three years in June 2025 for cutting a Taiwan-Penghu cable ([GlobalSecurity](https://www.globalsecurity.org/wmd/library/news/taiwan/2025/taiwan-250612-cna05.htm)). In March 2026 the barge Hai Hong Gong 66 allegedly damaged the Taiwan-Matsu No. 3 cable, and prosecutors opened an investigation ([Focus Taiwan](https://focustaiwan.tw/society/202604010018)). The PLA rehearsed a blockade of Keelung and Kaohsiung in its Justice Mission 2025 exercise in December 2025. Two Baltic Sea cables were cut in November 2024, and whether the cause was sabotage or an accident remained disputed. Finland seized the tanker Eagle S in December 2024 after the Estlink 2 power cable and four telecom cables were damaged.
ops.reading: The Party cuts cables through vessels it can disown. Each cut looks like seamanship gone wrong, and each one tests repair times, backup capacity and the courts. The pattern teaches the observer to see accidents. When a crisis comes, a dozen accidents in one night can isolate the outlying islands and slow Taiwan's link to the world. This is Stratagem 1, deceive the heavens to cross the sea. The Kremlin's shadow fleet of tankers offers a second set of vessels it can disown.
ops.coreEvent: Another Taiwan submarine cable suffers damage involving a mainland-crewed vessel before 2029.
ops.gapText: Technology Architecture. Taiwan's links to its islands and the world run through too few cables and too few repair ships.
ops.fix: Pair redundancy with prosecution. Put sensors on every corridor and open a case for every cut. Backup capacity makes each cut survivable.

script.text: A sand barge drags its anchor across the Matsu cable at four knots.
A cable under the Baltic Sea goes dark and a tanker sits above the break.

ops.title: The Biolab Story
ops.label: March to December 2022
ops.brief: In March 2022 the Russian Defense Ministry announced that it had found documents proving that American-funded laboratories in Ukraine had worked on biological weapons. Within days a spokesman for the foreign ministry in Beijing demanded that Washington explain.
ops.record: The Pentagon's Biological Threat Reduction Program had funded work on public health laboratories in Ukraine for years, to secure dangerous pathogens and track outbreaks. Russia convened Security Council meetings in March 2022 to press its claim. The United Nations' disarmament chief told the Council that the UN was not aware of any biological weapons programs in Ukraine. American officials called the claim false. The foreign ministry in Beijing repeated the demand through its spokespeople.
ops.reading: The story worked because a true thing sat under the lie. The program existed and the laboratories existed, and the invented part was the weapon. This is Stratagem 20, muddy the waters to catch the fish. Beijing's echo gave the claim a second voice in places Moscow could not reach. The cost to the Kremlin was small and the cost to the answer was large, because each denial repeated the charge.
ops.gapText: Data Architecture. The public record on overseas laboratory work was thin enough that a lie could fill the space around it.
ops.fix: Publish what overseas health and safety programs do and fund before an adversary describes them.

script.text: The foreign ministry in Beijing repeats the charge and calls on Washington to explain.

ops.title: The Inspector Satellite
ops.label: 2029 to 2034
ops.brief: An orbital analyst at Vandenberg watches a mainland satellite drift to within 20 kilometers of an American missile-warning satellite in 2031. The same satellite has parked beside three others that year and left each time before anyone said a word.
ops.record: Shijian-21 towed a dead Beidou satellite to a graveyard orbit in January 2022. Shijian-25 docked with Shijian-21 in geostationary orbit in July 2025 for the first apparent refueling there. The two separated on November 25, 2025. The Space Force's vice chief said in March 2025 that five mainland satellites had practiced dogfighting in low orbit. Russia destroyed its own satellite Cosmos 1408 in an anti-satellite missile test in November 2021 and scattered debris across low orbit.
ops.reading: The Party parks its inspectors next to America's most valuable satellites and watches the response. Silence teaches it that close approach is normal, and a crisis later finds its servicers already in place with arms that can grab or blind. This is Stratagem 13, stomp the grass to scare the snake. Moscow showed the blunt version in 2021 by destroying a satellite of its own.
ops.coreEvent: American officials report in public that a mainland satellite closed within 10 kilometers of an American national security satellite in geostationary orbit before 2034.
ops.gapText: Technology Architecture. America's key satellites are few, large and unable to move out of the way.
ops.fix: Publish every close approach and field satellites that can move.

ops.title: The Prepositioned Grid
ops.label: October 2026 to December 2028
ops.brief: A water utility engineer on Guam finds a scheduled task on a server in January 2028 that no one on his team created. The task sits dormant and reaches out to a router in a neighbor's office.
ops.record: CISA, the NSA and the FBI warned on February 7, 2024 that Volt Typhoon had placed itself inside the networks of American critical infrastructure to enable disruption in a crisis. Some of that access had lasted at least five years. Microsoft reported in May 2023 that the group targeted infrastructure on Guam. The Justice Department charged six Russian military intelligence officers in October 2020 for attacks that included the power outages in Ukraine in December 2015 and December 2016.
ops.reading: The Party places its access in peacetime and saves it for the week it matters. In a Taiwan crisis, outages on Guam and at West Coast ports slow the forces that would respond. This is Stratagem 2, besiege Wei to rescue Zhao, with the homeland as the target that relieves pressure at the Strait. Russian military intelligence showed in Ukraine what such access can do.
ops.coreEvent: American agencies disclose new footholds of the Party's hackers in American operational networks before 2028.
ops.gapText: Technology Architecture. Utilities run operational systems on networks that an intruder can reach and hold for years.
ops.fix: Pair coordinated eviction with segmentation of operational networks and manual fallbacks tested every year.

ops.title: The Gas Valve
ops.label: September 2021 to December 2022
ops.brief: In April 2022 a Polish gas utility told its customers that Russian pipeline deliveries would stop the next morning. The dispute behind it was over how Poland paid its bill.
ops.record: Russia supplied a large share of the gas that Europe burned before 2022. Gazprom cut deliveries to Poland and Bulgaria on April 27, 2022 after both refused to pay in rubles. Flows through the Nord Stream 1 pipeline fell through the summer of 2022 and stopped at the end of August. Explosions damaged the Nord Stream pipelines in September 2022, and responsibility remains contested. The European Union cut its use of Russian gas sharply by buying liquefied gas elsewhere.
ops.reading: Russia sold cheap gas for two decades and let Europe build its industry around it. This is Stratagem 28, lure the enemy onto the roof and remove the ladder. The cheap supply was a slope Europe walked down by choice, and the price came due in the winter that followed. Buyers in Asia took the discounted fuel Europe left behind.
ops.gapText: Business Architecture. A continent built its industry on one supplier and called the arrangement trade.
ops.fix: Cap the share any one supplier may hold of a critical input, and keep a second source in operation before the first is needed.

script.text: Gazprom cuts deliveries to Poland and Bulgaria after both refuse to pay in rubles.
Flows through Nord Stream 1 stop at the end of August.

ops.title: The Cartel Contract
ops.label: October 2026 to December 2028
ops.brief: A chemist at a Customs laboratory in Chicago opens a parcel declared as industrial dye in May 2027. The powder matches a precursor the Party scheduled in 2025, and the invoice routes through a trading house in Hyderabad.
ops.record: The Party agreed in November 2025 to control more fentanyl precursors after the Busan meeting ([White House](https://www.whitehouse.gov/fact-sheets/2025/11/fact-sheet-president-donald-j-trump-strikes-deal-on-economic-and-trade-relations-with-china/)). On February 20, 2026 the Supreme Court struck down the tariffs imposed under emergency powers, the fentanyl tariff among them ([SCOTUSblog](https://www.scotusblog.com/cases/learning-resources-inc-v-trump/)). American overdose deaths fell in 2024 and 2025.
ops.reading: Enforcement becomes a dial the Party turns with the trade calendar. Cooperation tightens before summits and loosens during disputes, while brokers shift to unscheduled analogues and third-country routes. The opium trade ran the other way in 1839, and the Party remembers which side paid. This is Stratagem 16, let the enemy off in order to catch them.
ops.coreEvent: The Party suspends or visibly slows precursor enforcement cooperation during a trade dispute before 2029.
ops.gapText: Application Architecture. Enforcement depends on the Party's cooperation, and the Party times that cooperation to its own calendar.
ops.fix: Build enforcement that works without the Party's cooperation through designations, chemical tracing and payment analytics.

ops.title: The Standards Seat
ops.label: 2029 to 2032
ops.brief: A junior engineer from a Texas telecom firm attends her first 3GPP meeting on 6G in 2030. The rapporteur, the chair and half the contributors on her work item come from firms that answer to mainland law.
ops.record: The Commerce Department eased rules in 2019 and 2024 so American firms could keep working in standards bodies alongside listed mainland companies. The Party's delegates entered bodies such as the ITU and 3GPP as newcomers and now draft much of the text. The ITU elects its leadership at plenipotentiary conferences every four years.
ops.reading: Standards bodies reward whoever shows up with engineers and drafts. The Party funds both at scale and turns seats into rules that suit its surveillance-friendly designs. The host ends up obeying rules the guest wrote. This is Stratagem 30, make the host and the guest exchange places.
ops.coreEvent: Delegates from firms under mainland law hold the most rapporteur and chair posts in 3GPP's 6G work items in 2030.
ops.gapText: Architecture Principles. The United States treats standards as private business while the Party treats them as national strategy.
ops.fix: Build a standards workforce with public support and let merit decide every contribution.

ops.title: The Fourth Quarter
ops.label: October 2031 to May 2032
ops.coreEvent: Two or more allied governments attribute separate incidents to coordinated action by the Party-state and the Kremlin before 2033.
ops.brief: In the autumn of 2031 a deputy national security adviser reads three alerts in one hour. A payment rail has cleared a sanctioned cargo, a cable has gone dark in the Baltic, and a rumor about a laboratory is trending in six languages.
ops.record: Each strand of this scenario has a documented precedent. The mBridge pilot settled cross-border payments between four central banks in 2022. Baltic Sea cables were cut in November and December 2024. Russia's Defense Ministry alleged American biological laboratories in Ukraine in March 2022. Volt Typhoon sat inside American infrastructure for years before its disclosure in 2024.
ops.reading: No single alert is the operation. The three together are, and each actor has reasons to let the others take the blame. A state that answers each alert in its own department answers none of them. This is Stratagem 35, chain the stratagems.
ops.gapText: Governance Architecture. Three alerts reached three departments, and no one owned the whole.
ops.fix: Give one standing body the authority to read separate incidents as one campaign, and publish the thresholds that make it act.

script.text: The first alert lands. A payment rail clears a sanctioned cargo.
The second alert lands. A cable goes dark in the Baltic.
The third alert lands. A rumor about a laboratory trends in six languages.

arcs.name: Three Powers
arcs.blurb: The United States and its allies against the Party-state and the Kremlin, one domain at a time.

arcs.name: The Partnership
arcs.blurb: Two powers who do not trust each other coordinate against a third. Learn where the partnership holds and where it strains.
